figures.original_caption_text: Figure 1. Center: Unitree G1 humanoid performing loco-manipulation, walking between tables to place and pick objects for 54 loops with our RGB-based sim-to-real policy. Surrounding: diverse simulated scenes used for training. Website: https://viral-humanoid.github.io

figures.original_caption_text: Figure 2. VIRAL teacher-student pipeline. Phase 1: In simulation, a privileged RL teacher policy π teacher receives full-state proprioception and exteroception of the task information and outputs WBC commands. Phase 2: A vision-based student policy π student observes only RGB images and sim-to-real proprioception and is trained to imitate the teacher policy via DAgger and behavior cloning.
